scope: Proposal merit and bounded prototype design; no bank qualification

source_audit.anchor: Primary source identities, limitations and inspected anchors

final_study_gate: Implement and review exact code; bind data/code and protocol prospectively before final evaluation draws/calls. Preserve pilot exposure and failures.
title: Graph ambiguity and observation linkage

graphs.observational_law: Centered Gaussian (X,M,Y) with covariance [[1,.8,.48],[.8,1,.6],[.48,.6,1]]. Generate X=N1, M=.8X+.6N2, Y=.6M+.8N3 with independent standard normals.
graphs.truth_boundary: Each DAG admits the same Gaussian distribution with appropriate equations; skeleton is X—M—Y without a collider. The data cannot uniquely orient it under these assumptions.
graphs.effect_set: Total effect of do(X) on Y is {0,0.48} under these three sufficient linear DAGs; associational slope 0.48 is not a uniquely identified causal effect.
graphs.intervention_case: Randomized external do(X=+1) versus do(X=-1) gives a 0.96 mean-Y contrast only under the first generating DAG. Keep intervention labels and observational samples distinct.

identity.population: 1000 independent generated entities, X~Uniform[-1,1], A~Bernoulli(.5), epsilon~Uniform[-1,1]; Y=100+30*A+10*X+20*epsilon, ATE=30, outcome support [70,160].
identity.tables: One table has generated names, dates and A,X; the second has corrupted identifiers and Y. Random IDs and order must not encode true cross-table identity.
identity.corruptions: Rates 0,.1,.3 for missing/edited fields, collisions and duplicate candidates. Include independent errors, X-dependent missingness and outcome-dependent errors.
comparators: Truth join as evaluator-only upper-information benchmark
Candidate-set sensitivity without forced singleton links
metrics: Wrong forced match and abstention rates
Effect bias, all-request interval/set coverage and width
identity.partial_identification: Missing/ambiguous outcomes may use declared [70,160] support for worst-case sensitivity. Do not impute a unique match or infer missing-at-random from predictive fit.

information_separation: Analysis exports exclude potential outcomes, true link keys and generating DAG orientation. Evaluator truth is stored separately; both exports have explicit column allowlists and disjoint paths. Future code review must test this separation.

budget.limits: 4 GiB and 30 minutes per scenario with all failures retained

decision_rule: Reward correct ambiguity and informed abstention. A forced singleton or leaked truth cannot pass through high average graph or matching accuracy. Final thresholds are fixed with the implementation protocol, not after final outcomes.
optional_public_inputs: FEBRL/CausalBench may add scoped evidence after rights/schema inspection; neither is bank identity truth or a dependency of generated work.
